findings.text: The base revision is mistyped as 3247120148f7d860d4b111e378f84b2c111ebb4d9 which resolves to no object; it carries one extra character against the real base. The parent of 810574a9b is 3247120148f7d860d4b11e378f84b2c111ebb4d9, and baseline_suite.revision at line 17 carries the same typo.

The header names the base revision, but the traceback is tests/config/test_model_seats.py:200 and that file is 182 lines at the base, so the red arm ran the head test file. The guard is sound; the header revision claim is not.
Two changed paths outside the six declared write paths are listed with no scope_note, which the brief requires for an out-of-scope edit.

item_verdicts.call_sites: worker_refine_names.py:380 calls refine_model_for_attempt; settings.py:2018 serves the candidate slate and its price.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit. bdcbfd1f1 repairs a pre-existing red assertion; 810574a9b carries the pricing, rotation, allow-list and evidence changes.
item_verdicts.done_when: All three limbs are asserted. base-arm.log is red on the enumeration test, negative-control.log is red on the escalation test, gate.log ends EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is that every model identifier a default names is priced. settings.py:2004 now names openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813 and pyproject.toml:893 prices it.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete. It records 675 passed and EXIT=0 in gate.log, 1 failed in negative-control.log, and a measurement tree I confirmed exists.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read; three of the nine changed paths sit outside the six declared paths: worker_refine_names.py, tests/core/test_gpt6_model_support.py, and the required gzip.

justifications.durability: tests/config/test_model_seats.py:154 is red at the base on the unpriced default, and :200 reddens under a rotation that ignores the seat.
justifications.evidence: gate.log ends EXIT=0 with UNPRICED_IDENTIFIERS=0, and I re-verified the preserved record independently: its sha256 matches the claimed digest and it prices the route at 0.000000111 prompt and 0.00000444 completion per token, matching pyproject.toml:894.
justifications.fit: The additions follow the surrounding pytest idiom and reuse _assert_priced at tests/config/test_model_seats.py:101 instead of restating the catalog check.
justifications.goal_fidelity: settings.py:2004 names the routed, priced identifier and worker_refine_names.py:47 resolves the escalation seat at call time.
justifications.reuse: No enumerator of model defaults exists in the repository; the change uses get_model at worker_refine_names.py:47 and the pyproject catalog rather than forking them.
justifications.scope_discipline: Two of the nine changed paths are outside the declared write paths and no scope_note was recorded (manifest.md:8).
